title: TRACERS AND HALOS READ AT 4K
why: His order of 2026-10-12 on the graphics program: add all of it, item 15 (reading the game on a 4K TV). At 4K the world is drawn twice as big, but tracers and sparks kept their thin 1080p shape, so a burst of fire read as hairlines. They are now a quarter thicker at 4K. And at 4K, or with HUD SIZE LARGE FOR TV, every body you can see and you yourself stand on a soft dark halo, so a pillager or a machine stands out from a busy floor from across the room; anything you cannot see gets none, so it gives nothing away. 1080p STANDARD looks exactly as before. Nothing about play changes.
now: At 4K tracers and sparks are thicker, and every body you can see stands on a soft dark halo (also with LARGE FOR TV).
